sections.title: Letter T
paragraphs: The name of this letter sounds like (T) /ʃ/. Its main sound is heard in the word (table) /teɪ.bəl/, which means a piece of furniture with legs. This letter has three different sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: First, press your tongue tip behind your upper teeth to block the air. Release it with a sharp burst without voice. Next, start with your tongue there and release into a hiss. Push your lips slightly forward. Put a hand on your throat. Your voice stays quiet for both sounds.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: You hear the sound in (ten) /tɛn/ at the start of words or before vowels. Before an unstressed u, it makes the sound heard in (nature) /neɪ.tʃər/. In words like (castle) /kæ.səl/, it is a silent letter.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not place your tongue directly on your front teeth. Keep the tip on the ridge behind your upper teeth. Also, remember not to make any sound for the silent letter in (listen) /lɪ.sən/.
